CustomObject.description: Data Update Center form configuration published from the Form Builder. Each row overrides (or adds to) one Custom Metadata record (Data_Update_Form__mdt, Data_Update_Form_Field__mdt, Data_Update_Appearance_Template__mdt) keyed by its fullName, so staff publish with the app's own permission sets instead of Metadata API rights. Read and written only through DucFormConfigStore.
CustomObject.label: DUC Form Config
